newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac to make first outing Saturday since defeat.
newsitem.headline: Chirac to make first outing Saturday since defeat.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac, closeted in his Elysee Palace since his centre-right coalition was crushed at the polls on Sunday, will make his first outing on Saturday with a minister from his new left-wing cabinet.
Chirac will inaugurate the renovated Fine Arts Museum of the northern city of Lille together with new Culture Minister Catherine Trautmann, his office said on Friday.
He is scheduled later to address a benevolent fund congress in the city.

The French leader, whose position was seriously diminished by the election defeat which now forces him to rule in "cohabitation" with the left, declined to appear with his new cabinet on the presidential palace steps on Thursday after a first meeting under his uneasy chairmanship.
